Sense Organs
Sense organs are the body parts that help us to know what is happening around us. We have five sense organs - eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin.
We see and watch things with our eyes.
We hear sounds with our ears.

Rainy Season
We wear raincoats. They keep us dry. Raincoats are made of rubber. We also use umbrellas and gumboots.
Winter Season
We wear woollen clothes in winter. They keep us warm.
